title: Statistics
invalidDates: Enter valid dates with the end on or after the start.
error: Could not load the data. Please try again.
empty: No recorded matches for these filters.
viewSupporting: View the matches supporting this indicator
rateRule: Wins ÷ (wins + losses + draws). Undefined and ambiguous legacy results are excluded.
legacyRule: Older results awaiting confirmation are excluded from win rate. Original information is preserved; we do not infer results from scores or missing winners.
teamRule: In cooperative play, the result belongs to the team and applies to its participants.
ratingRule: Only your rating contributes to this average. Zero is a rating; absence is not zero.
historyScope: Based on your recorded history, using the selected filters.

metrics.friend-only-win: Only my friend won among us

durationRule: We add recorded durations only. Coverage shows how many matches have duration; missing duration is not zero.
olderCompact: Of these, {{count}} older results await confirmation
companyIntro: Choose a friend to explore matches where you both participated.
sharedWins: Wins shared by both of us
otherWins: Another won; neither of us won
sharedWinNote: Each person’s wins include shared victories.
pairEvolution: Competitive: me {{mine}} wins · friend {{friend}} wins · {{draws}} draws
scoreDirectionNote: These are recorded values, not a performance ranking. Some games reward lower scores; without stored comparability rules, we do not choose a “best” score.
companyScope: Accepted friends in matches you participated in, using the selected filters.
noCompany: No shared matches recorded for these filters yet.
companyPrivacy: Only matches you both participated in count, while the friendship is accepted. We do not expose your friend’s separate history, notes or private ratings. External sharing keeps identities anonymous.
pairDrawNote: A draw means an explicit first-place tie, including both or just one of us. If both lost, another participant’s win or draw is distinguished. Older or inconsistent results are never inferred.
firstRecorded: First match in your recorded history: {{date}}
collectionScope: Entries still in your collection added during this period. Game filters the collection; mode restricts it to games with that mode in your history.
ownedNotRecorded: {{count}} owned games with no recorded match
emptyCollection: No current entries added in this period match these filters.
noRecordedMatch: No matches in your recorded history
collectionLimits: AddedAt indicates collection entry, not purchase date. Historical acquisitions, removals and currencies are incomplete, so these prices are not annual expenses and values with unknown currencies are not added together.
yearScope: Full year, retaining the original game and mode filters.
emptyYear: No recorded matches for this year and filters yet. Choose another year.
rateInsufficient: No game has at least {{minimum}} known results for this highlight.
noFirstGames: No newly recorded games in this year.
noYearHighlight: Not enough data for this highlight yet.
firstHistoryNote: First according to your recorded history, not necessarily the first time you played.
anonymousShare: Sharing excludes friends’ names, photos and identifiers.
yearResultCoverage: {{known}} known results · {{unknown}} without a known result
shareLocalNote: The image is prepared locally. Choose a destination or save the image from the iPhone share sheet.
shareFailed: Could not prepare sharing. Your card and data are still available.
